canonical_terms: Full acceptance materialization for all 1,152 active requirements is not required before YADF vertical-slice work may begin.
Exactly 59 independently audited typed custom contracts are currently ACCEPTANCE_READY.
Generic, expected-derived, template-based or placeholder acceptance must not be retained to claim a formal acceptance gap of zero.
Source statements, stable IDs, scope, criticality, structural reconciliation and the 27 approved business decisions remain effective.

Before implementation, every vertical slice must declare its exact requirement IDs, elaborate concrete acceptance for every included pending requirement, obtain human approval for that slice acceptance, declare runtime/API/data/UI evidence obligations, and pass clean-checkout validation before slice acceptance.
Renderer C1 and Renderer C2 remain historical signed artifacts but must not be used as proof of final acceptance outside the 59 independently audited typed contracts.

This decision does not approve any particular vertical slice, source-code implementation, runtime adapters, runtime mutation claims, YADF production implementation, deployment, or final product acceptance.
Progressive elaboration must not weaken requirement scope, criticality, approved business decisions or evidence obligations.
